Claude of Duty is exactly what it sounds like: a tactical FPS in your browser, made by @mattshumer_ with one smart prompt, Claude Opus 5 builders, and memory-isolated critics. No art assets.
The OG Gauntlet Loop game is now playable on PlayDrop.
